subject.title: improve(ui): move Sessions from the sidebar More menu into Settings

question: Should Sessions become Settings-only even though upgrades will remove existing users' saved Sessions sidebar pins?
rationale: The code can implement either navigation policy safely, but choosing between a cleaner administrative Settings hierarchy and preserving an existing personalized sidebar entry is a product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve Settings-only placement
options.body: Accept removal of stored Sessions pins, retain `/sessions` as a deep-link alias, and merge after exact-head checks are green.

options.title: Preserve sidebar pinning
options.body: Add Sessions to Settings without removing it from the customizable sidebar route set, preserving existing user preferences at the cost of two navigation entry points.

recommendation.title: Approve Settings-only placement
recommendation.body: Accept removal of stored Sessions pins, retain `/sessions` as a deep-link alias, and merge after exact-head checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work establishes direct ownership context for the sidebar and Settings navigation design involved here.
